title: Abbott's lower bound for diagonal Ramsey numbers
statement:
For every natural number $n \ge 0$, the diagonal Ramsey number satisfies
\[
  r\bigl(2^n + 1,\; 2^n + 1\bigr) \ge 5^n + 1,
\]
where $r(k, l)$ denotes the least number of vertices $N$ such that every graph on $N$ vertices contains either a clique on $k$ vertices or an independent set on $l$ vertices. (H. L. Abbott)
hypotheses_covered: n is an arbitrary natural number
